description: This Java class, LoanProductSheetPopulator, is responsible for populating an Excel workbook sheet with data related to loan products. It formats and writes various loan product attributes into the sheet, including ID, name, principal, interest rates, repayment terms, and dates. The class extends AbstractWorkbookPopulator and uses Apache POI to manipulate the Excel document.

classes.name: LoanProductSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with loan product data, providing layout setup, data writing, and formatting features.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and fills the loan product sheet within the provided Workbook with the list of LoanProductData objects, applying the specified date format.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets the column widths and header labels for the sheet.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of LoanProductData objects to be populated.

methods.name: getProductsSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the products list.
